observations.summary: Reuters reports Latvian armed forces warned residents near the Belarus/Russia borders and activated interceptor drone and air-defence units; Lithuania's National Crisis Management Centre separately reported NATO fighters scrambled for an unidentified object approaching from Belarus. Origin, intent, airspace entry, and outcome are unverified. Similar alerts occurred November 1-3; this is a new defensive activation, not proof of a new interstate escalation phase.
observations.title: Latvia issues air-threat shelter warnings; NATO Baltic fighters scrambled
